purpose: Provide the dialogue model with a compact, authoritative personality expression block without granting it authority to rewrite personality or World State.
input_order: speaker knowledge available for this scene
expression_rules: Do not mention trait labels in dialogue.
Express personality statistically across conversation, not as a gimmick in every sentence.
The same personality should remain recognizable across calm, stress, duty and off-duty contexts.
Current state may amplify or suppress expression but not replace the core personality.
Culture affects how traits are expressed and interpreted; it does not overwrite them.
Avoid caricature: a dry character need not be dry in every line; a humorous character need not joke constantly.
Professional duty can temporarily increase formality without changing underlying personality.
Relationship history can make a guarded person warmer toward trusted individuals without globally changing trust speed.
